stem: The number of followers of a new online account \(w\) weeks after it was created is modeled by \(F(w) = a(b)^{w}\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are positive constants. According to the model, the account had 150 followers 1 week after it was created and 1,350 followers 3 weeks after it was created. According to the model, how many followers did the account have when it was created?
solution: When the account was created, \(w = 0\) and \(F(0) = a = 50\).
verify:
a, b = symbols('a b', positive=True)
sol = solve([a*b - 150, a*b**3 - 1350], [a, b], dict=True)
assert len(sol) == 1 and sol[0][b] == 3
F0 = sol[0][a]
assert F0 == 50
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [F0]
